shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Separate menus and tooltips from report content.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Runs a refresh from the masthead.
components.css: .ds-sync { min-height: 40px; padding: 7px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--ink,#222220); border-radius: 7px; color: var(--bg,#f8f8f8); background: var(--ink,#222220); font: 600 13px 'Segoe UI Variable Text','Segoe UI',sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity .16s; } .ds-sync:hover { opacity: .8; } .ds-sync:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus,#4b6520); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: The page title shares a baseline with sync status above the charcoal report. The Token and cost trend shares the report with total usage. Rules and right-aligned figures organize the detailed data.
keyCharacteristics: Installed UI fonts and tabular figures
Charcoal feature with a pale lime trend

rules.name: One featured trend
rules.body: Save the highlight for the main time series and its key.

rules.name: Shared edges
rules.body: Align the masthead, report and data sections to the same page gutters.

dos: Keep quota and chart labels readable in both themes.
donts: Avoid decorative charts or unfamiliar navigation controls.
